scope: Historical deterministic checks and static audit; no third-party extension execution or workflow integration test.

commandContext.method: Call actual ExtensionRunner.prototype.createCommandContext with an inert base context; also inspect ExtensionContext and ExtensionCommandContext declarations.

publishedSkills.method: Pi loadSkillsFromDir and formatSkillsForPrompt on the published skills directory.

skillCollisions.method: Pi loadSkills with includeDefaults=false, explicitly combining published skills and the existing user skill directories in both orders. Not a full extension startup test.

scenarios.note: tdd and teach each produced a duplicate collision diagnostic; distinct collision names remain 43.

upstreamAlignment.method: Count regular files and compute SHA-256 for matching relative paths in fixed source archives; byte differences are not semantic classifications.

curation.retained: Version pins, source URLs, relevant implementation findings, semantic differences, and compact observed results.
curation.discarded: Downloaded source archives and extracted trees, full registry/history responses, full per-file hash printout, duplicate drafts, and transient local paths.
curation.notClaimed: Full runtime compatibility, exact August upstream port base SHA, latest status after the observation date, or safety certification.
